title: WP900 G8 semantic admission requires identical start state and the same task executor across arms
target: F2-WP-900 generation 8 independent reentry evidence binder and any successor semantic GWT/J-Space promotion

material_observation.execution_context_gap: ProbeExecutionContext binds runner identity, execution surface, runtime engine/config, environment, dependencies, boot and exact source, but it does not bind the mutable application/world starting state, checkpoint/store generation, deterministic seed/clock state, or a pre-arm state digest.
material_observation.intervention_execution: The accepted G7 target workflow builds fixture_components(), seals the whole persistent loop, reads a real GWT reentry bundle, records DELIVERY/UPTAKE/REENTRY and derives intervention raw bytes from the bundle downstream CellOutput.
material_observation.control_execution: The same workflow launches a separate Python process whose control_code only serializes nonbroadcast_input_sha256 plus broadcast_sha256=null and reports reentry_observed=false. It does not execute the same whole-loop/GWT downstream task from a cloned identical starting state.
material_observation.causal_consequence: Shared source/boot/environment plus equal nonbroadcast_input_sha256 is insufficient to establish a matched behavioral intervention/control experiment when mutable state and the task executor differ. A later binder can be perfectly hash-bound and still compare two different experiments.

falsifier_hypothesis: Without a cryptographically bound identical pre-arm state and one shared task executor/output ABI, G8 can close evidence-identity circularity only at mechanism scope. It cannot establish that broadcast semantic content caused a task-level semantic outcome difference.
counterhypothesis: The current G4/G7 contract is sufficient because the nonbroadcast input digest and execution-context digest capture all causally relevant state. This counterhypothesis is falsified if any mutable task-relevant state or executor behavior exists outside those digests.

hard_counterexample.setup: Run a valid intervention after mutable state S1 has been established, but generate the no-broadcast control artifact without executing the same task from S1 (or from a byte-identical clone of S1). Keep exact source, boot, environment and nonbroadcast input digest equal.
hard_counterexample.false_green: The current lineage/hash gates can still accept the pair even though an observed task-level difference could be caused by unmatched pre-state or unequal execution procedure rather than the broadcast intervention.

required_discriminator_before_semantic_p: Bind an explicit pre_arm_state_sha256 (or exact checkpoint/store snapshot identity) covering every mutable task-relevant state surface used by the downstream task.
Bind the exact task-executor code/ABI identity and execute that same task executor for intervention and control; the manipulated broadcast dimension must be the only intended difference.
Start both arms from byte-identical cloned state, or prove reset/replay equivalence with exact pre-state readback before each arm.
Use one condition-blind task output schema and capture raw task outcome bytes plus post-state digest for both arms.
Record deterministic seed/clock/input identities when they can affect the task; otherwise classify the comparison UNKNOWN_CONFOUNDED.
Add a hard negative where source/boot/nonbroadcast input are identical but pre-state differs; the semantic comparator must fail closed rather than report a causal semantic difference.
Add a hard negative where pre-state is identical but intervention/control use different task executors; the comparator must fail closed.
Preserve semantic_gwt_runtime_credit=0 and jspace_runtime_credit=0 for G8 mechanism evidence unless a distinct target-executed matched-task semantic discriminator closes these confounds.
scope_fence: This falsifier does not invalidate accepted G4/G7 exact target-component scopes. It only blocks promotion from those mechanism/readback scopes into task-semantic GWT/J-Space causal authority.
next_exact_action: G8 owner should keep its binder explicitly mechanism-scoped and absorb the independent-observation regressions already routed. Before any later semantic GWT/J-Space promotion, add a target-executed matched-task experiment with byte-identical pre-state, the same task executor/output ABI, condition-blind outcome readback and pre/post state hashes.
